name: Click Here For Love: Reconnected
source:
Click Here For Love just got more personal!

Play as 2-3 different characters as you help Lil Niva, Leyna, and Annie save their popular dating website, 'Click Here For Love'.

Now, users can decide what to do each day in order to win one of the girls...but things aren't so easy!

White has only 7 days to prove his worth...or else the evil Anthoknight will take his place...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316081255/http://pikasite.mew151.net/product.php?id=3]official site[/url]]
translation:
《Click Here For Love》变得更加私人化了！

扮演 2 至 3 名不同角色，帮助莉尔·妮瓦、莱娜和安妮拯救她们广受欢迎的交友网站“Click Here For Love”。

现在，玩家可以决定每天要做什么，以赢得其中一名女孩的芳心……但事情并没有那么简单！

怀特只有 7 天时间证明自己的价值……否则邪恶的安托奈特就会取代他……

[来自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316081255/http://pikasite.mew151.net/product.php?id=3]官方网站[/url]]
